limits_note: Strict extension allowlist: only video/audio/image/archive/doc extensions (.mp4 .mkv .mp3 .flac .png .pdf .zip .7z .tar .iso .torrent .kdbx ...). No .bin/.parquet/.npy — this kills it as a raw dataset store. CSAM scanning via Cloudflare tooling purges the entire account on any hit.
